goal: Check for any successful sshd Accepted authentication events on db-1 within ±30 minutes of the burst (2026-07-26T09:22:52Z), to determine if any brute-force attempt succeeded.
what_to_summarize: any Accepted password or Accepted publickey events on db-1 in the window
source IP and username of any successful auth
timestamp of any successful auth relative to the burst
auth method of any successful auth
total count of successful auths in window

params.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T08:52:52Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T09:52:52Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND event.outcome == "success"
| STATS accepted   = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                              message LIKE "*password*",  "password", "other"),
           source.ip, user.name
| SORT accepted DESC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T08:52:52Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T09:52:52Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| LIMIT 5

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T08:52:52Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T09:52:52Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND (message LIKE "*Accepted*" OR system.auth.ssh.event == "Accepted")
| LIMIT 5

params.query:

| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T00:00:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T23:59:59Z"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.11"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND event.outcome == "success"
| EVAL auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                           message LIKE "*password*", "password", "other")
| EVAL port = CASE(message LIKE "*port *", TO_INT(SUBSTRING(message, LENGTH(message) - 5, 5)), null)
| KEEP @timestamp, user.name, auth_method, port, message
| SORT @timestamp ASC
| LIMIT 20
